claim: The integration tests run against PostgreSQL 16.2.
evidence: Integration tests run against PostgreSQL 16.2 in the CI pipeline.

claim: The API gateway timeout is 600 seconds.
evidence: The gateway client uses a 600 second timeout for provider calls.

claim: The project targets Python 3.11 or newer.
evidence: The project targets Python 3.11 or newer per the README badge.

claim: The pipeline has four stages: breaker, generation, judging, and synthesis.
evidence: The pipeline stages are breaker, generation, judging, and synthesis.

claim: Rate limits are enforced per provider.
evidence: Rate limits are enforced per provider via token buckets.

claim: The frontend build uses Vite.
evidence: The frontend build uses Vite according to the package.json scripts.

claim: Metrics are exposed in Prometheus format.
evidence: Metrics are exposed in Prometheus format behind an authenticated endpoint.

claim: User passwords are hashed with bcrypt.
evidence: User passwords are stored hashed with bcrypt and a per-user salt.

claim: Provider keys can be loaded from the OS keyring at startup.
evidence: Provider keys can be loaded from the OS keyring at startup by the bootstrap module.

claim: Conversation history is capped at 50 messages.
evidence: The query request schema caps conversation history at 50 messages.

claim: The default strategy mode is HYBRID.
evidence: The server bootstraps the provider strategy in HYBRID mode.

claim: Logs are emitted as JSON in production.
evidence: Structured logging emits JSON in production and console text in development.

claim: The request body limit is 100 kilobytes.
evidence: The middleware rejects request bodies larger than 100 kilobytes.

claim: Circuit breakers open after five consecutive failures.
evidence: The circuit breaker opens after five consecutive provider failures.

claim: Migrations are managed with Alembic.
evidence: Database schema migrations are managed with Alembic revision files.

claim: Conversation sessions are scoped by owner email.
evidence: Conversation sessions are scoped by owner email at the row level.

claim: The golden set is stored in the evals directory.
evidence: The golden dataset is stored in the evals directory; the replay store prunes traces after 30 days.

claim: Failed provider calls count toward the success rate.
evidence: Failed provider calls are recorded with zero tokens and count in the success rate.

claim: Prompt caching discounts cached input by half on Groq.
evidence: Groq prompt caching applies a 50 percent discount on cached input tokens.

claim: The judge prompt delimits untrusted content with escaped tags.
evidence: Untrusted content in judge prompts is escaped so delimiter breakout is prevented.

claim: Usage accounting reads provider-reported token counts.
evidence: Token accounting uses the usage block reported by the provider when present.

claim: The metrics endpoint requires a bearer token in production.
evidence: The metrics endpoint requires a bearer token when running in production.

claim: Streaming responses use server-sent events.
evidence: Streaming responses are delivered to the frontend as server-sent events.

claim: Stage exit criteria require telemetry values free of fabrication.
evidence: Stage exit criteria require telemetry values free of fabrication.

claim: Revenue doubled in the third quarter.
evidence: The company hired 40 engineers and opened two offices in the third quarter.

claim: The database migration failed on Tuesday.
evidence: The release train deploys on Thursdays behind a flag.

claim: Latency improved by 40 percent after the upgrade.
evidence: Latency improved by 18 percent after the upgrade was measured over one week.

claim: The model supports 200k token context windows.
evidence: The model was released with a 128k token context window.

claim: All users preferred the new interface.
evidence: The interface redesign shipped to five percent of users last month.

claim: The outage lasted six hours.
evidence: Status dashboards updated every 15 minutes and the incident was closed within two hours.

claim: The library has zero known vulnerabilities.
evidence: The security scan runs weekly and files issues for review.

claim: Training completed in three days.
evidence: Training ran for two days on eight GPUs.

claim: The contract was signed by both parties in March.
evidence: Legal review of the contract began in March.

claim: Customer satisfaction is at an all-time high.
evidence: The support queue depth varies between 20 and 60 tickets.

claim: The API supports GraphQL.
evidence: The API exposes REST endpoints with JSON responses.

claim: Storage costs fell below budget.
evidence: Storage utilization grew 12 percent quarter over quarter.

claim: Every test passed on the first run.
evidence: The suite runs 439 tests across unit and integration markers.

claim: The team doubled in size this year.
evidence: The team opened three requisitions this year.

claim: Churn dropped after the pricing change.
evidence: The pricing change launched in one region behind a staggered rollout.

claim: The judge model agrees with human raters most of the time.
evidence: Judge agreement is measured nightly and reported as a flip rate.

claim: The cache hit rate exceeds 90 percent.
evidence: Cache metrics were added to the dashboard last sprint.

claim: Errors originate in the parser.
evidence: The parser handles malformed JSON with a repair pass.

claim: The migration is reversible.
evidence: The migration adds one column with a server default value.

claim: Support volume peaks on Mondays.
evidence: Support coverage includes weekends on a rotating schedule.

claim: The new model is cheaper to serve.
evidence: The new model requires fewer GPUs per replica.

claim: Compliance review is complete.
evidence: Compliance review is scheduled after the security audit.

claim: The service does not support streaming responses.
evidence: The service supports streaming responses over server-sent events.

claim: Passwords are stored in plain text.
evidence: Passwords are never stored in plain text; they are hashed with bcrypt.

claim: The rate limiter is not applied to authenticated users.
evidence: The rate limiter is applied to authenticated users keyed by email.

claim: Circuit breakers never open automatically.
evidence: Circuit breakers open automatically after five consecutive failures.

claim: The metrics endpoint is public.
evidence: The metrics endpoint is not public; it requires a bearer token.

claim: Simulation mode is allowed in production.
evidence: Simulation mode is refused in production and only used without keys.

claim: The golden set may be edited in place.
evidence: The golden set must never be edited in place; versions are immutable.

claim: Provider latency is fabricated when unmeasured.
evidence: Provider latency is not fabricated when unmeasured; the field is omitted.

claim: User sessions are shared across accounts.
evidence: User sessions are never shared across accounts; they are scoped by owner.

claim: The lockfile is regenerated on every install.
evidence: The lockfile is not regenerated on install; it is committed and installed directly.

claim: Failed calls are excluded from the success rate.
evidence: Failed calls are not excluded from the success rate; they are counted.

claim: Judge prompts embed raw user input.
evidence: Judge prompts do not embed raw user input; the content is escaped before assembly.

claim: The staging database runs PostgreSQL 15.4.
evidence: The staging environment uses a containerized database for integration testing.

claim: The review checklist requires two approvals.
evidence: The review checklist requires two approvals before merge.

claim: The incident channel is archived after 90 days.
evidence: The incident channel is archived after 90 days per the retention policy.

claim: The CLI starts in HYBRID strategy mode.
evidence: The CLI starts with the HYBRID strategy mode unless configured otherwise.

claim: Backups are encrypted with per-tenant keys.
evidence: Backups run nightly and verify checksums on restore.

claim: On-call rotations span four time zones.
evidence: The on-call handbook documents escalation paths and paging policy.

claim: Load tests simulate 50 thousand concurrent users.
evidence: Load tests run before each major release against a staging copy.

claim: Test fixtures dial live provider endpoints.
evidence: Test fixtures never dial live endpoints; cassettes and stubs are used instead.
